rubric_notes: Complete: release, full a.22.1 family list with sunids and members, homology endpoints with scope and no warnings; superfamily-level probable common ancestry only, with a.22.1.1 as the closest family-level grouping and TAFs as a separate family; nucleosome-forming role explicitly not transferred; H1/H5 and enzyme name-matches excluded with the statement that absence of a SCOPe claim is not proof of non-homology; limits on periodic update, search window and lack of alignment evidence stated. Minor: describes a.4.5.13 only as 'a different superfamily' when it is also a different fold. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct a.204.1.2 vs a.204.1.4, shared a.204.1 with homology_scope 'sf' verified. Distinguishes fold similarity from the superfamily-level homology assertion, rejects HisE activity/pathway, substrate, mechanism and template transfer to the hypothetical MazG-like protein, cautions on unidentified ligand, and states that different families are not evidence of unrelatedness or convergence. All must_include and must_avoid criteria met.

Correct families within c.55.1 (53067), fold c.55 Ribonuclease H-like, homology record and duplication comment supported; domain examples d1rgia1/2 and d4foea1-4 with boundaries supported by searches. Superfamily-level ancestry stated with no family-level claim; rejects shared substrate, reaction, role, mechanism, ligand, and template use. Glycerol-kinase empty-search remark not in bundle but carries no factual payload. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Families 47241/47253/100951, protein node 47263, superfamily 47240, fold a.25 and class a all verified; homology_scope sf flag and bimetal comment supported; empty 'ribonucleotide reductase' search correctly reported. Interpretation: separate families within one homologous superfamily, divergence expected, superfamily does not imply shared biochemistry; chemistry labelled as unverified background; explicitly rejects analog/convergent reading; names required further evidence (domain lineage comparison, sequence/structure alignments, primary literature for bimetal-site residues and mechanism).

Strong interpretation: superfamily-level probable common ancestry, hedged by 'probably related' comments, distinct families, no function transfer, copper explicitly rejected for ephrin/PAD4, electron transfer not asserted, PAD4 catalytic domain separate, ephrin receptor folds distinguished. However the annotation and homology claims (superfamily copper comment, family 'lacking metal-binding site', 'mono-domain proteins', 'no warnings') are presented as verified but the evidence bundle contains only four search calls, so those API-dependent claims are unsupported by the bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Full lineage (class d, fold d.15, superfamily d.15.1, families .1/.2/.5) with sunids, Pfam, homology scopes, and example domains (d3by4b_ automated-match annotation, d2cr5a1, RBD domains) all supported by the bundle; superfamily-level ancestry with separate families; unsafe transfers cover conjugation, p97/VCP-type UBX partners and Ras binding; flags automated-match annotation and search-index limits. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Full verified lineage for all three families and superfamily c.23.1 with sunids and domain SIDs (d3chya_, d1r8ja2, d1m2ea_); superfamily-level probable ancestry stated, fold alone only structural. Rejects phosphoreceiver/phosphorelay for ODC wing and KaiA domain, ODC-wing catalysis, shared substrate/template, and quantitative claims. Does not explicitly reject transfer of circadian regulation to or from the KaiA N-terminal domain, only notes the family name.

Strong interpretation: superfamily positive homology claim, fold-level warning quoted from bundle, no non-homology inferred, family b.84.5.1 covers V1/A1. Hierarchy and sunids correct. But the claims that the Thermus domain is annotated 'complexed with adp' and that other A-subunit domains sit in b.49.1.2 and a.69.1.2 are not supported by any response in the bundle (no domain annotation or such search result present). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct 2.08 placements: f.21 (81344) with f.21.1 (81342), f.21.2 (81343; families f.21.2.1, f.21.2.2), f.21.3 (103501; family 103502). Clearly distinguishes shared fold from superfamily homology, states SCOPe makes no positive claim but also no negative/convergence claim, names needed independent evidence (alignments, FATCAT/BLAST), handles the f.21.3 'possible link' curator note as hypothesis not merger, and rejects function transfer. Annotation quotes are not in this bundle's search results but are accurate for 2.08. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct sibling-family placement under c.2.1 with correct sunids, homology scopes, and annotations supported by bundle. Interprets shared superfamily as probable common ancestry of the Rossmann core and explicitly denies shared substrate/cofactor/catalytic activity; warns against turning family names into same-ligand claims; requires family-specific experimental evidence for any transfer. Avoids analogy/convergence claims. Minor: domain-versus-whole-protein distinction only implicit. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct same-family placement and lineage, with caveats that family placement of designed proteins does not supply natural evolutionary history or function. Cites a compare endpoint result not present in the bundle. The family node's 'not a true family' annotation was not retrieved or mentioned, so the required annotation override is absent and the answer states SCOPe 'does assert a family-level (homology-bearing) relationship'. Bio capped at 2; factual 2. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct before/after: 1.69 d1t1ja_ c.137.1.1 in fold c.137 vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1; 2.08 d1t1ja1 (1-118) c.23.14.2 under superfamily c.23.14 (52309), d1f8ya_ unchanged. States SCOPe asserts probable common ancestry at superfamily level only, family-level sharing not asserted, no function transfer; notes the SID change rests on shared sunid and the l.1.1.1 records. Minor: 'SCOPe 1.69' label. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete artifact lineage (class l, l.1 Tags, l.1.1, l.1.1.1, N-terminal Tags, Synthetic), homology warning and homology_implied_by_level=false supported by bundle; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH mouse correctly identified. Explicitly states tag hit does not transfer VH classification or indicate ancestry. Limits on sequence, numbering, and other releases stated.

Correct 1.75 single-domain f.11.1.1 and 2.08 two-domain split with boundaries; sequence-tiling check (212+510=722) is sound. Strong inference that the chain holds two separately classified modules with no positive cross-module homology, and correct search guidance. Queried only 1.75 and 2.08 and explicitly cannot place the split at 2.04, leaving the required first-split release unidentified.

Complete: SIDs, boundaries, SCCS; four previously classified folds plus Prp8-specific d.394 for d3jb9a5; a4 family-level, a1-a3 superfamily-level homology only. Adds release history (d.394 present 2.07/2.08, beta-finger family already in 1.75) consistent with bundle. Thorough limits on SCOPe placement vs function and on 'newly observed'. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Covers all three required elements including the 're' flag and the canonical 34-residue repeat, and is honest that lengths were not retrieved. States 'all three carry a re note', a mild overgeneralization since d4cj9a_'s record lacks it, though consistent with the flag's own family-wide definition. Reasoning on repeat homology and heterogeneity is sound and caveats are strong.

Correct metadata supported by bundle; pins release=2.08 and names 2.08-stable; says periodic update does not replace stable release and is not a new release. Missing the content semantics of periodic updates (new PDB entries without rewriting older domains) and only implicitly covers preserving the dated label when periodic-only entries are used. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Accurate and bundle-supported: a.47.2.1 lineage for all four domains, fragment comment and 'ms' flag on every 1br0/1ez3 chain, automated match of d1dn1b_ to d3c98b_, 222 vs 120 residues with the single S/C difference correctly identified. Correctly concludes the fragment calls are partial-domain evidence for the same family and that 1dn1 B extends beyond them, with sound caveats on spectrin comment, absence-of-flag, and function. Does not explicitly state that the complete domain resolves the fragment-driven resemblance and supports the STAT-like interpretation. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correctly treats different-fold placement as absence of a positive claim rather than proof of convergence, and says cofactor geometry can converge. However, it declines to state that superfamily placement supports divergence ('cannot say whether the superfamily diversified divergently'), leaving must_include 2 only partially met, and the evidence-integration point is thin (no explicit topology/motif/function integration). Only c.2 and c.3 retrieved (sunids verified); the question's 'multiple superfamilies' is underexplored. Claimed empty search not in bundle (minor).

Correct 2.04 b.23.2.1 to 2.08 b.18.1.36, Cry unchanged b.18.1.3, shared superfamily b.18.1 remote homology, different families, no function transfer. Notes l.1.1.1 tag split and weak direct structural link. A noncentral PDB revision-date aside is accurate though not in its own bundle; not material.

Family placement retained as positive homology assertion; hf correctly read as caveat on d1ztra1's fold (different from exemplar, similar sequence and SSE count) that does not withdraw membership; family label does not establish shared 3D conformation so neither domain is a template for the other; same-partition splits with hf used explicitly or held out for fold-level targets; mutant status noted; limits stated. All release, lineage, comment and homology facts match the bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Verified lineage, sunids, boundaries, protein entries, fr flag (domain-set, not inherited, only heterogeneity entry, no warnings), cr9 comment noted without interpretation. Alignment: uncovered portion marked not observed, no full-length identity against it, PDB numbering caveat. Representative: fragment is a reason not to pick d1o5dt2 but is not a quality ranking; honestly refuses to name d1uc6a1 best without quality and membership data. Diversity: one protein-level entry but partial structural coverage. Clear limits list and next steps. Complete.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Recommends new superfamily in the existing fold conditional on topology match; family correctly framed as a close-ancestry claim; new fold tied to topology mismatch; explicitly refuses to read superfamily separation as nonhomology; frames result as a candidate hypothesis needing FATCAT, residue mapping and topology checks. All must_include met, no must_avoid violated. Cited a.1/a.1.1 SUNIDs, fold comment and homology warning are all supported by the evidence bundle.

All identifiers (d.144.1.7/88854, d.144.1.6/64411, d.144.1.4/56171 within d.144.1/56112, fold d.144, class d, release 2.08 with periodic update noted), homology records, annotation comments and the empty 'protein kinase-like' search are supported by the bundle. Superfamily read as probable common ancestry and the deepest justified level; separate families mean substrate recognition should not be treated as shared; phosphotransfer chemistry correctly flagged as background rather than SCOPe-verified. Rejects transfer of substrate specificity, catalytic-residue identity, regulatory mechanism, inhibitors and templates. Lists required evidence: same-release lineages, substrate-bound structures, activity and selectivity data, mutagenesis, sequence and structure alignment of substrate-binding and activation-loop regions, and regulatory literature. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.
